title: Buddhidhan's Administration
subtitle: A Mysterious Visitor Disrupts Suvarnapur’s Calm
summary: When a solitary and enigmatic young man arrives quietly in the bustling port town of Suvarnapur, his presence sparks curiosity and quiet unease. Against the backdrop of rivers and sea, his melancholic demeanor hints at secrets and stories yet to unfold. What draws him to this strange land—and what truths will his path reveal?
